fact: The article reports that Comoros has incubators, coworking spaces and programmes, including the UCCIA incubator launched in 2016 and the Comorlab coworking space opened in Moroni in 2018, and that AFD-backed incubators operate on the three islands.
title: L'écosystème d'innovation aux Comores : entre défis structurels et signaux prometteurs
